title: The Sovereign's Enemy
summary: Ha-Jun's return to Seoul rallies the human defenders. As the 50,000 Iron Demon Vanguard reinforces Gangnam, the true architect of the invasion emerges: Void General Xal'Khor.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing atop the dead 50-foot behemoth wide shot
panels.action: Rain pours down over Ha-Jun's crowned silhouette as steam hisses from the bisected monster's skull.

panels.shot: min-jae dropping his plasma rifle in breathless joy
panels.action: Min-Jae drops his rifle, tears streaming behind his glasses: 'HA-JUN!! HE'S BACK!!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: HA-JUN WAPAS AA GAYA!! WITH THE CROWN!!

panels.shot: captain baek saluting with bloody combat glove
panels.action: Captain Baek wipes sweat and blood from his brow, exhaling in massive relief: 'The Sovereign has returned.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Hamare paas sirf 5 minute bache the... Timely arrival, Your Majesty.

panels.shot: the 100-meter golden portal over gangnam flashing
panels.action: High above the intersection, the portal pulses violently as war horns sound from within.

panels.shot: general malgath and 50,000 iron demons pouring onto the streets
panels.action: The disciplined legions of iron demons flood the streets, forming impenetrable defensive shield-walls.

panels.shot: human citizens in buildings watching demons in stunned disbelief
panels.action: Civilians sheltered inside high-rise offices watch in amazement as demons fight alongside human hunters.

dialogue.text: Humanity ke itihaas mein pehli baar... Demons insaano ki dhaal ban kar khade the.

panels.shot: malgath landing beside ha-jun bowing head
panels.action: Malgath strikes his chestplate: 'Sector 4 perimeter is locked, My Sovereign!'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Bahar ke saare beasts barricade ke peeche push kar diye gaye hain!

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding: 'Good work, Malgath.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down from the behemoth: 'Lekin invasion force ka commander kahan hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh mindless beasts hain. Inhe control kaun kar raha hai?

panels.shot: sudden drop in ambient light across seoul
panels.action: Every streetlamp and neon billboard in Gangnam flickers and dies; absolute unnatural pitch-darkness falls.

panels.shot: sky tearing open into a jagged black antimatter rift
panels.action: A three-hundred-meter vertical crack tears through the clouds, glowing with toxic green void energy.

panels.shot: a colossal floating throne of black bone descending
panels.action: Descending from the rift: a floating throne made of thousands of fused human and demon skulls.

panels.shot: void general xal'khor full design reveal
panels.action: Seated on the throne: an 18-foot biomechanical Void General with a faceless mirrored visor, six bladed arms, and void tentacles.

panels.shot: xal'khor voice vibrating in mechanical digital distortion
panels.action: A voice like grinding metal broadcast directly into everyone's skulls: 'The biological anomaly Ha-Jun Kang.'

dialogue.speaker: xal_khor
dialogue.text: Main Void Primordial ka High Arbiter hoon. Your universe has been selected for recycling.

panels.shot: xal'khor raising one mechanical blade arm
panels.action: Xal'Khor points at Ha-Jun's crown: 'The Sovereign Relics are obsolete technology. Hand them over.'

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping off the dead behemoth to the asphalt
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands smoothly on the rain-slicked road, stepping toward the descending throne.

panels.shot: ha-jun mocking the void general
panels.action: Ha-Jun smirks with icy disdain: 'Recycling? Tumhari vocabulary bohot advanced hai machine ke liye.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Lekin tumhare jaisi kitni machines ko maine pehle scrap banaya hai, pata hai?

panels.shot: xal'khor visor flashing crimson red
panels.action: The mirrored visor pulses angry red: 'Disrespect detected. Commencing biological purge.'

panels.shot: xal'khor launching six void antimatter missiles
panels.action: Six black spheres of pure antimatter launch from Xal'Khor's shoulders, homing in on Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating chains of ruin in midair
panels.action: Ha-Jun whips the Chains of Ruin; the black chains form a rotating gravitational shield in front of him.

panels.shot: antimatter missiles detonating against the chains
panels.action: The six missiles detonate with terrifying white-hot flashes, but the gravity field absorbs 100% of the blast.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing eclipse devourer through the smoke
panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts through the explosion smoke at Mach 2, the dark-matter greatsword raised overhead.

panels.shot: xal'khor deploying six high-frequency energy blades
panels.action: Xal'Khor's six arms deploy humming green energy blades, meeting Ha-Jun's strike in midair.

panels.shot: titanic midair deadlock between the two commanders
panels.action: Ha-Jun's single greatsword deadlocked against Xal'Khor's six energy blades; shockwaves rattle buildings.

panels.shot: xal'khor tentacles whipping around ha-jun ribs
panels.action: Four razor-tipped tentacles lash out from Xal'Khor's back, wrapping around Ha-Jun's ribs to crush him.

panels.shot: ha-jun bone gauntlet and armor hardening instantly
panels.action: Ha-Jun's internal bone density activates; the crushing tentacles cannot compress his ribcage even an inch.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bone of the Forgotten... Tumhara hydraulic grip meri haddiyo ko touch bhi nahi kar sakta!

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing the fang of abyss with left hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun pulls the void dagger with his left hand, slicing cleanly through all four tentacles in one reverse cut.

panels.shot: xal'khor recoiling as black cybernetic fluid sprays
panels.action: Xal'Khor jerks backward, severed tentacle cables spewing green sparks and black coolant.

panels.shot: ha-jun delivering downward heel kick to xal'khor chest
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives an axe-kick into Xal'Khor's chestplate, rocketing the 18-foot general into the street tarmac.

panels.shot: xal'khor crashing into gangnam intersection crater
panels.action: The Void General smashes into the asphalt, digging a 40-foot trench through the street.

panels.shot: ha-jun hovering overhead with wings wide and sword drawn
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers thirty feet above the smoking crater, pointing his greatsword down: 'Recycle this.'
